_comment: Tracker → role mapping for the GR1T2 + gripper migration (research/36).
The user wears 2 motion trackers on the *elbow / proximal forearm*
(PICO Connect 'Forearm Tracking Enhanced' calibration mode).  They are
still bound to the role 'left_forearm' / 'right_forearm' so the rest
of the codebase can find them, but the device's forearm_wrist_offset
must be ~0.28 m (typical adult forearm length) instead of the 0.12 m
used when the tracker was on the wrist itself.
The hips tracker is OPTIONAL (skipped when the user is on the no-
tracker rig).  When present, it drives waist_pitch/yaw via the
WaistEstimator (kept disabled by default in the gripper migration to
avoid the Virtual Desktop AI body tracker noise documented in CLAUDE
Replace each 'TODO' below (or the generic key names hips / *_arm_lower)
with your tracker's real serial number when running with physical
Vive trackers.  Virtual-Desktop-inferred AI segments use the keys as-is.
